Q01.name: Fetch
Q01.description: {giver} asks you to recover a lost keepsake from {target}. Speak to its keeper to collect it, then bring it back.
Q01.completion: {giver} accepts the keepsake with a grateful smile.

steps.text: Collect the {item} from the keeper at {target}.
steps.result: The keeper returns the {item}. Carry it safely back to {giver}.

steps.text: Hand the {item} to the keeper at {giver}.

Q02.name: Delivery
Q02.description: {giver} has a sealed parcel for {target}. Pick it up from the keeper, then deliver it to the keeper at {target}.
Q02.completion: The keeper at {target} accepts the parcel. The delivery is complete.

steps.result: The keeper entrusts you with the {item} for {target}.

steps.text: Deliver the {item} to the keeper at {target}.
steps.result: The keeper checks the seal and accepts the parcel.

Q03.name: Investigation
Q03.description: {giver} is mapping a safe trail. Inspect the trail notes with the keeper at {target}, then return and report your findings.
Q03.completion: {giver} marks the safe trail on the map. Your investigation will help the next travelers.

steps.text: Inspect the {item} with the keeper at {target}.
steps.result: The trail notes show a washed-out crossing. The marked upper path is safe. You record the finding.

steps.text: Report the safe route to the keeper at {giver}.
steps.result: You explain the damaged crossing and the safe upper path.

Q04.name: Bandit Clearing
Q04.description: Bandits are blocking the trail approach to {target}. Defeat them there, then return to {giver} and report that the route is safe.
Q04.completion: {giver} records the cleared trail. Travelers can use the approach to {target} again.

encounter.arrival: Bandits block the trail approach. Clear the route before reporting back.
encounter.flee: You retreat from the blocked trail. The bandits remain; return when you are ready.
encounter.defeat: A passing patrol brings your party to safety. Recover and return to clear the blocked trail.

steps.text: Defeat the bandits blocking the approach to {target}.
steps.result: The bandits retreat. The trail approach is safe.

steps.text: Return to {giver} with news of the cleared trail.
Report the cleared trail to the keeper at {giver}.
steps.result: You report the victory and the safe trail approach.
